scope: Optional isolated per-call timeout experiment; no production safety claim

cases.lost_reply_broker_crash: passed: bounded calls return, consumer watchdog confirms quiescence; no new execution command
cases.restart: passed: broker restart leaves consumer disarmed/quiescent; no automatic rearm/resume

limits: 200 ms per call is not an end-to-end stop deadline
scheduler/process stalls and physical GPIO unproven
no cancellation or rollback of commands already committed
UDP only; TCP timeout/reconnect recovery not validated
